🇷🇺🇺🇦⚡️ — Ukrainian military officials report that a "Geran" drone was spotted in the Odesa region, reaching speeds of up to 800 km/h.

They speculate that a new engine is being tested on the "Geran-4."

Notably, yesterday, Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine is not intercepting (according to his data) almost half of the jet drones, and that those drones fly 200-300 km/h slower than the tested modification.

🇬🇧⚡️ — Near the British airbase of Fairford, which is used by the U.S. Air Force for strikes against Iran, five men of non-white appearance were detained in three white vans, according to British police.

According to one version, the detainees are suspected of potentially using explosives to plan an attack on the airbase. Bomb disposal robots inspected the vans, after which explosives experts removed materials for analysis. Judging by the markings, the vehicles were used by the Fuel2U fuel delivery service, and the barrels from these vehicles are being inspected by the bomb disposal experts.

In a video released by journalists from a helicopter, it is possible to see how close the detained individuals were to the airbase and the American B-1B Lancer bombers stationed there.
